issues.title: Customer unable to login via Microsoft Azure SSO
issues.description: Customer reports an error 400 bad_request during OAuth callback handshake with Microsoft tenant.

issues.title: Payment API returns 500 when customer completes checkout
issues.description: Stripe webhook listener throws unhandled exception on recurring subscription metadata schema validation.

escalationHistory.reason: Basic troubleshooting verified Stripe payload mismatch; requires technical investigation into API webhook parser.

issues.title: Database synchronization deadlock during high-volume customer CSV import
issues.description: PostgreSQL deadlock detected on customer_tags junction table during asynchronous bulk contact insertion.

escalationHistory.reason: Customer reported repeated timeout on 50,000 record import. L1 reproduced in staging.
Database query analysis shows row-level lock contention on customer_tags. Requires schema re-indexing and query rewriting.

issues.title: Customer password reset email delivery delay exceeding 15 minutes
issues.description: SendGrid webhook queues backlogged on transactional notification worker pool.

issues.title: Production API crash: memory leak on long-lived WebSocket connections
issues.description: Node cluster instances encountering out-of-memory errors after 48 hours of continuous real-time presence broadcasting.

escalationHistory.reason: Heap dump analysis shows 800MB retained listeners on EventEmitter inside ws client wrapper. Escalated to Principal Engineer.

issues.title: Dashboard loading slowly on accounts with over 10,000 active tickets
issues.description: The aggregate count queries are performing full table scans without composite index on (tenant_id, status, created_at).

issues.title: Add export to CSV for filtered issue list and reports
issues.description: Allow managers and stakeholders to export currently applied issue filters with full metadata into RFC 4180 CSV.

issues.title: Payment page redesign with inline error feedback
issues.description: Update the checkout modal to show instant card field validation without page refresh.

issues.title: Fix mobile navigation drawer backdrop touch propagation
issues.description: Tapping backdrop on Safari iOS 17 causes underlying ticket card to trigger click event.

issues.title: Improve login form input validation and error messaging
issues.description: Ensure invalid domain syntax is flagged immediately with friendly localized messaging.

issues.title: Email notification not triggered when ticket priority is raised to Highest
issues.description: Notification dispatcher skipped event because filter condition required both status change and priority change.

escalationHistory.reason: Verified email server is up. Code review of event notification worker needed.

issues.title: Customer search returning incorrect fuzzy matching results on hyphenated names
issues.description: Elasticsearch edge-ngram analyzer tokenize rule strips hyphens instead of preserving word boundaries.

issues.title: Add ticket priority and support level quick filter chip on board
issues.description: Provide 1-click filter chips for L1, L2, L3 and Highest priority on the kanban board.

issues.title: Implement customer activity timeline with rich metadata badges
issues.description: Display an unified visual feed of all ticket interactions, phone logs, email threads, and escalations.

issues.title: Customer portal SSL certificate rotation automated check failure
issues.description: Let's Encrypt ACME DNS-01 challenge failed due to Cloudflare API token permissions expiry.

escalationHistory.reason: Automated monitoring detected certificate expiration in 48 hours. L3 DNS access required.

issues.title: Weekly automated PDF report generator timing out on large tenant datasets
issues.description: Chromium headless renderer memory cap exceeded when generating reports with over 200 pages.

issues.title: Audit log export to AWS S3 bucket fails with AccessDenied
issues.description: IAM role trust policy missing the new external-id header introduced in the latest tenant migration.

escalationHistory.reason: IAM role policy configuration requires cloud infrastructure engineering privileges.

issues.title: Customer satisfaction survey score calculation rounding defect
issues.description: CSAT percentages rounded down using Math.floor rather than Math.round.

issues.title: Billing invoice generator creates duplicate line items on multi-currency accounts
issues.description: When exchange rate converts back and forth, precision difference creates second line item.

escalationHistory.reason: Customer finance team reported duplicate lines on GBP/EUR billing. L1 confirmed and escalated to Technical Support.

issues.title: Add bulk tag editor to issue table selection
issues.description: Allow support leads to select multiple tickets and append or remove shared tags in a single action.

issues.title: Live chat widget disconnects unexpectedly during customer tab switch
issues.description: Heartbeat ping dropped when browser throttles background timers in Chrome.

escalationHistory.reason: Customer reported repeated disconnections during support chats. L2 technical reproduction required.

issues.title: Support agent routing round-robin assigning to offline agents
issues.description: Presence status cache TTL in Redis is set to 10 minutes instead of 30 seconds.

issues.title: Customer canned response shortcuts not loading in Spanish locale
issues.description: Translation bundle missing fallback keys for macro triggers.

issues.title: Zendesk historical ticket sync failing on tickets older than 3 years
issues.description: Zendesk incremental export API paginator encounters rate limiting (429) without exponential backoff.

escalationHistory.reason: Customer requested full history migration. Repeated 429 errors from Zendesk.
Requires resilient retry worker with token bucket rate-limiting algorithm.

issues.title: Customer survey NPS feedback webhook integration
issues.description: Post webhook events to GoldMine Slack channel when customer submits negative score (<6).

issues.title: Offline ticket cache synchronization collision on reconnect
issues.description: SQLite database local edits overwrite server changes instead of performing 3-way merge.

escalationHistory.reason: Conflict resolution engine in mobile client requires vector clock algorithm fix.

issues.title: Push notification badge count does not decrement on ticket resolution
issues.description: APNs payload badge count not updated when ticket is resolved from desktop browser.

issues.title: Biometric FaceID authentication prompt fails after app backgrounding
issues.description: LocalAuthentication context invalidated prematurely when user switches apps.

issues.title: Camera attachment upload crashes on HEIC format photos above 15MB
issues.description: Image compressor exceeds max texture dimensions on iPhone 15 Pro Max photos.

issues.title: Dark mode theme persistence across app cold starts
issues.description: Check device system preference and save user override in secure storage.

issues.title: Audit log streaming Kafka consumer lagging by 45 minutes
issues.description: Consumer group partition rebalance loop triggered by health check timeout on audit worker.

escalationHistory.reason: Kafka partition rebalancing requires cluster configuration tuning and timeout increase.

issues.title: Customer account impersonation token security audit trail
issues.description: Ensure every support engineer impersonation session records reason code and target account ID.

issues.title: Automated database backup integrity validation test runner
issues.description: Spin up disposable Postgres container weekly and execute pg_restore test suite.

issues.title: Employee offboarding automated revoke script failing on Google Workspace OAuth
issues.description: Admin SDK directory API requires service account delegation domain update.

escalationHistory.reason: HR triggered offboarding script returned 403 authorization error. L2 review of admin credentials needed.

issues.title: Customer documentation search instant indexing webhook
issues.description: Rebuild Algolia search indexes automatically whenever Markdown files are merged into main.

issues.title: Self-service pricing calculator slider visual feedback stutter on Safari
issues.description: RequestAnimationFrame missing during rapid range input dragging on WebKit.

issues.title: Customer status page RSS feed XML encoding malformed for unicode characters
issues.description: Unescaped ampersand in maintenance alert title breaks XML parser.

issues.title: GDPR cookie consent banner blocking accessibility keyboard navigation
issues.description: Focus trap in banner prevents screen reader navigation to page header.

issues.title: Customer account deletion webhook missing subscription cancellation trigger
issues.description: When tenant deletes user account, recurring billing schedule remained active in Stripe.

escalationHistory.reason: Critical financial defect involving automated recurring charges. L3 engineer assigned directly.

issues.title: Kanban board card drag ghost image misalignment on Chromium Linux
issues.description: DPI scaling factor causes drag feedback avatar to render 20px off cursor position.

issues.title: Customer time tracking timesheet submission validation error
issues.description: Support technician cannot log more than 12 hours in single entry without manager override.

issues.title: Payment API gateway timeout on 3D Secure verification flow
issues.description: Card issuing bank redirect hangs on Safari mobile iframe sandbox restrictions.

escalationHistory.reason: Customer reported repeated 3DS verification timeout on European credit cards.

issues.title: Create sprint velocity burndown chart component
issues.description: Build interactive Recharts line chart mapping ideal sprint burn against real daily story point burn.

issues.title: Customer SLA calculation engine with weekend exclusion rules
issues.description: Ensure SLA remaining countdown timer pauses during configured business off-hours and regional holidays.

issues.title: Add sub-task hierarchy link visual connector in issue details
issues.description: Display linked sub-tasks with completion checkbox and direct inline creation.

issues.title: Customer invoice PDF branding custom logo alignment
issues.description: Ensure uploaded customer vector logos maintain aspect ratio in PDF header without clipping.

issues.title: Two-factor TOTP authenticator backup recovery codes generation
issues.description: Provide 10 single-use cryptographically secure alphanumeric backup codes during 2FA setup.

issues.title: Search query highlights in issue summary and description
issues.description: Highlight matched search terms in bright subtle yellow background across search results.

issues.title: Customer account lockout policy triggered after 5 consecutive bad passwords
issues.description: Temporarily freeze account login for 15 minutes with exponential lockout delay.

issues.title: Support ticket satisfaction survey automated email trigger after resolution
issues.description: Send customer CSAT link 2 hours following ticket status change to Resolved.
